robustness_policy.missing_or_short_collections: Legal candidate failure; record failed/blocked checks without evaluator exception.
robustness_policy.missing_probe: Candidate launch/contract failure where attributable; evaluator-unsupported remains null, never a numeric zero.
robustness_policy.timeouts: Bounded per transition; host/evaluator timeout is infrastructure invalid, not a partial score.
robustness_policy.candidate_mutation: Forbidden; evaluation runs against a scratch copy and verifies the source tree remains unchanged.
robustness_policy.input_transport: Normal Unity Input System Mouse only; no gameplay action is invoked through the read-only probe.
